messages.content_text: Currently backtesting and came across this A+ setup that I wanted to share. My Bias was Bearish as we had a bunch of Unfilled HTF FVG's bellow and PDL as well. The confluences for this trade was: A 1Hr IFVG CE, 1hr FVG CE, 0.705 level on Fib, and a 5M RB entry. The reason why I thougt this was a good trade was primarily due to the large 1Hr IFVG that i wanted price to retrace to and reject off it and in pair with the 1hr fvg, I wanted this to be respected and proceed downwards. After price came up and hit the CE of the IFVG and FVG, I wanted to wait for a entry trigger such as the 5m RB ce which is shown below to get a cleaner entry and avoid being stopped at break even which is what would of happened if i just limited the ce of the IFVG and FVG. My target was TDO (Green line), securing a 1:5 rr.
